tradeoffs.selectionLimitation: GitHub did not enqueue ready/synchronize PR events. Supported manual dispatch selected every retained owner, so hosted unrelated and startup-only classes were not observed.
tradeoffs.observationGap: There are not three independent first-attempt hosted observations for each unrelated, startup-sensitive, and conservative-full class, and no hosted cold-cache control.
tradeoffs.maintainerDisposition: On 2026-09-15 the maintainer explicitly accepted the unavailable complete hosted observation set as a documented known gap and requested continuation after current CI. Missing samples remain unperformed and support no median, range, speedup, or completed-performance claim.
